statements.label: Theorem 1
statements.restatement: For x in X with P c(x) >= 0, contacts containing T={0,1,2,4,7,9} (image of paper T_11 under sigma -> sigma o (34)), pi*=pi_0, and B = -g3+g6-g12+g13+g18 < 0: Phi_{c(x)}(O) >= 0 on SO(4); in the 8-distinct nonreal chart with g8>0, ab(c-d) > d^2(a+b+c+d), a=g15,b=g8,c=g18,d=-B. Branch A<0 not covered.
